title: Front-tape label alphabet
statement: For natural numbers $C$ and $d$, define the finite label alphabet consisting of the fixed labels $rN,rN1,rN2,e0,e1,dh,dd,mh,md,xh,xd,x1,x2,th,tdl,t1,bh,bd,b1,fin,fin2,fin3$, together with labels $ldA(i)$ for $i\in\mathrm{Fin}(C+2)$ and labels $ldD(i)$ for $i\in\mathrm{Fin}(d+1)$.
